4. Bayesian state-space model fits

Each population by sub-season is fit independently with a Bayesian state-space model: a latent AR(1) effort and CPUE process at a per-fit temporal resolution (capped per population so a thin series is not over-resolved), a negative-binomial observation model, and gear-deployment effort. Fitting is the slow step. Healthy: each fit with enough data samples without a wall of divergences; the convergence gate below is the formal check.

# ---- 7.6 BSS MODEL RUNS ----
timer_start("5_BSS_model_runs")
message("\n", strrep("=",60), "\n BSS MODEL RUNS\n", strrep("=",60), "\n")
bss_catch_groups <- catch_groups
message(sprintf("Running BSS for: %s\n", paste(bss_catch_groups, collapse=", ")))
bss_all <- list()
ar_resolutions <- list()   # AR resolution actually used, per fit (for the gate report)
ar_escalation_log <- list()  # improvement 7: one row per fit attempt (ar_escalation_log.csv)
.kept_attempt <- list()      # fit label -> the attempt index whose stanfit was retained
for(cg in bss_catch_groups) {
  for(pop in c("shore","private_boat")) {
    for(ss in subseasons) {
      label <- paste0(pop, "_", ss$name, "_", cg)
      message(sprintf("\n--- BSS: %s ---\n", label))

      days_ss <- prep_days_crab(ss$start, ss$end, params, L_eff_model)
      summ_ss <- prep_population_summary(dwg, pop, ss$start, ss$end, params)

      n_int <- nrow(summ_ss$interview)
      n_eff <- nrow(summ_ss$effort_index)

      if(n_eff < 5 || n_int < params$bss_min_interviews) {
        message(sprintf("  Insufficient data for BSS (%d effort, %d interviews < %d min), using PE only.\n",
                    n_eff, n_int, params$bss_min_interviews))
        bss_all[[label]] <- list(C_sum=NA, E_sum=NA, pe_fallback=TRUE,
                                 population=pop, subseason=ss$name, catch_group=cg)
        next
      }

      # ================================================================================
      # improvement 7: AR RESOLUTION ESCALATION LADDER (mirrors the pooled driver)
      # ar_escalate = FALSE (default) -> one attempt at the sub-season's fixed period_bss
      # (or, with ar_adaptive = TRUE, at the data-driven capped resolution). Identical to
      # previous runs. ar_escalate = TRUE -> start at the finest rung and refit one rung
      # coarser on each convergence-gate failure, stopping at the first rung that passes.
      # Every attempt is a real multi-hour fit and is logged to ar_escalation_log.csv.
      # ================================================================================
      eff_d_ladder <- summ_ss$effort_index |>
        filter(count_sequence <= params$bss_max_count_seq) |>
        left_join(days_ss |> select(event_date, day_index), by = "event_date") |>
        filter(!is.na(day_index))
      # 2026-09-14 (D3): the AR period is resolved PER POPULATION, not per sub-season.
      # period_bss belongs to the sub-season and a sub-season holds BOTH populations, so
      # until now the shore all-gear fit and the boat all-gear fit were locked to the same
      # period with no way to separate them. The first D3 ladder moved both and its port
      # total was 90% boat movement; see 03_R_functions/bss_gear_period.R for the numbers.
      # bss_gear_period() returns NULL under the flat form; the per-population form ships
      # since A32, so this line sets the shore all-gear fit to weekly.
      .period_ss <- bss_gear_period(params, pop, ss$gear_regime) %||% ss$period_bss
      if (!identical(.period_ss, ss$period_bss))
        message(sprintf("  AR period from gear_period_bss[[%s]][[%s]]: %s (the sub-season's own is %s)",
                        pop, ss$gear_regime, .period_ss, ss$period_bss))
      ar_ladder <- bss_ar_ladder(days_ss, eff_d_ladder, pop, params,
                                 fixed_resolution = if (isTRUE(params$ar_adaptive)) NULL else .period_ss,
                                 gear_regime = ss$gear_regime)
      # 2026-09-04: resolved PER FIT; see the matching block in the pooled driver.
      .esc_on <- .bss_resolve_ar_escalate(params, pop, ss$gear_regime)
      .incumbent_passed <- FALSE; .incumbent_pi_rel <- Inf
      if (.esc_on)
        message(sprintf("  AR escalation ladder [%s/%s]: %s", pop, ss$gear_regime,
                        paste(ar_ladder, collapse = " -> ")))

      # improvement 6: post-filter interview floor (the guard above counts UNFILTERED
      # interviews, so it reads looser than what the CPUE likelihood sees).
      min_fitted <- params$bss_min_interviews_fitted %||% params$bss_min_interviews

      is_shore <- (pop == "shore")
      is_allgear <- (ss$gear_regime == "all_gear")
      is_ringnet <- (ss$gear_regime == "pot_closure")

      fit <- NULL; bss_data <- NULL; too_thin <- FALSE

      for (attempt in seq_along(ar_ladder)) {

        # 2026-09-04: `.esc_on`, not isTRUE(). See the long note at the same line in
        # BSS-GH-pooled-CPUE-model.Rmd: isTRUE() is FALSE for every scoped form of
        # ar_escalate, which silently refits the SAME resolution on every rung. The gear
        # track has not yet been run with a scoped ar_escalate, so this one was latent.
        force_res <- if (.esc_on) ar_ladder[attempt] else NULL
        bss_data_try <- prep_bss_crab_gear(days_ss, summ_ss, cg, params, pop, .period_ss,
                                  gear_exclude = ss$gear_exclude %||% character(0),
                                  gear_regime = ss$gear_regime,
                                  ie_data = ie_data,
                                  force_resolution = force_res)

        n_fitted <- bss_data_try$.n_interviews_fitted %||% bss_data_try$IntC
        if (n_fitted < min_fitted) {
          message(sprintf(paste0("  Post-filter interviews %d < bss_min_interviews_fitted = %d ",
                                 "(pre-filter count was %d); PE fallback."),
                          n_fitted, min_fitted, n_int))
          bss_all[[label]] <- list(C_sum=NA, E_sum=NA, pe_fallback=TRUE,
                                   population=pop, subseason=ss$name, catch_group=cg)
          too_thin <- TRUE
          break
        }

        # Per-fit sampler tuning: shore all-gear is the most complex posterior
        # (4 gear types, 43 weekly periods since A32); pot-closure fits are data-sparse
        # and benefit from tighter adaptation. All other fits use defaults.
        if(is_shore && is_allgear) {
          fit_iter    <- params$bss_iter_shore_allgear
          fit_warmup  <- params$bss_warmup_shore_allgear
          fit_treedep <- params$bss_treedepth_shore_allgear %||% params$bss_max_treedepth_default
          fit_delta   <- params$bss_delta_shore_allgear %||% params$bss_adapt_delta_default
        } else if(is_ringnet) {
          fit_iter    <- params$bss_iter_ringnet %||% params$bss_iter_default
          fit_warmup  <- params$bss_warmup_ringnet %||% params$bss_warmup_default
          fit_treedep <- params$bss_treedepth_ringnet %||% params$bss_max_treedepth_default
          fit_delta   <- params$bss_delta_ringnet %||% params$bss_adapt_delta_default
        } else if (!is_shore && is_allgear) {
          # private_boat all-gear. Previously the only fit with no per-fit settings, which is
          # why it was the only fit that could not sample (see the params block above).
          fit_iter    <- params$bss_iter_boat_allgear      %||% params$bss_iter_default
          fit_warmup  <- params$bss_warmup_boat_allgear    %||% params$bss_warmup_default
          fit_treedep <- params$bss_treedepth_boat_allgear %||% params$bss_max_treedepth_default
          fit_delta   <- params$bss_delta_boat_allgear     %||% params$bss_adapt_delta_default
        } else {
          fit_iter    <- params$bss_iter_default
          fit_warmup  <- params$bss_warmup_default
          fit_treedep <- params$bss_max_treedepth_default
          fit_delta   <- params$bss_adapt_delta_default
        }

        message(sprintf("  Stan [attempt %d/%d, %s AR]: iter=%d, warmup=%d, max_treedepth=%d, adapt_delta=%.2f, init_r=%.2f\n",
                    attempt, length(ar_ladder), bss_data_try$.ar_resolution,
                    fit_iter, fit_warmup, fit_treedep, fit_delta, params$bss_init_r %||% 2))

        timer_start(paste0("BSS_", label, "_att", attempt))
        # 2026-08-26: guarded wrapper, 03_R_functions/bss_stan_fit.R. On the happy path
        # this is rstan::stan() with the same arguments, same seed, same RNG stream, so
        # fits are unchanged. It adds two pre/post checks that would have turned the
        # 2026-08-25 "dim(X) must have a positive length" failure into a one-line error
        # naming the missing Stan data variable: a data-completeness check before the
        # sampler, and an empty-stanfit check after it. log_file keeps the Stan console
        # for this fit in output_dir, so a chain failure stays diagnosable even though
        # this chunk is results='hide'.
        fit_try <- bss_stan_fit(
          file = here("02_stan_models", params$bss_model_file),
          data = bss_data_try,
          label = sprintf("%s att%d", label, attempt),
          log_file = file.path(output_dir,
                               sprintf("stan_console_%s_att%d.log", label, attempt)),
          chains = params$bss_chains, iter = fit_iter, warmup = fit_warmup,
          control = list(adapt_delta = fit_delta, max_treedepth = fit_treedep),
          seed = params$bss_seed,   # was missing: gear-resolved fits were not reproducible
          cores = params$bss_cores,
          # B51 (2026-09-29): the initial-value radius, run_config$bss_init_r (0.5 shipped;
          # rstan's default is 2, the value every render before B51 used). D33.
          init_r = params$bss_init_r %||% 2
        )
        timer_stop(paste0("BSS_", label, "_att", attempt))

        gate_try <- tryCatch(
          bss_compute_gate(list(fit = fit_try, pe_fallback = FALSE), label,
                           catch_par        = "C_expected_sum",
                           effort_par       = "E_sum",
                           max_impact_sd    = params$max_divergence_total_impact_sd %||% 0.10,
                           max_div_fraction = params$max_divergence_fraction %||% 0.05,
                           ar_resolution    = bss_data_try$.ar_resolution),
          error = function(e) NULL)

        # 2026-09-04: keep this rung's ANSWER as well as its sampler diagnostics; see the
        # matching block in the pooled driver and 03_R_functions/bss_ar_rung_summary.R.
        .rung <- bss_ar_rung_summary(fit_try)
        # 2026-09-06: adequacy PER RUNG; see the note at the same point in
        # BSS-GH-pooled-CPUE-model.Rmd and 03_R_functions/bss_rung_adequacy.R.
        .radq <- if (isTRUE(params$ar_rung_adequacy %||% TRUE) && length(ar_ladder) > 1)
                   bss_rung_adequacy(fit_try, bss_data_try) else
                   bss_rung_adequacy(NULL, NULL)
        # 2026-09-29 (D29): every rung's block CV; see the same block in the pooled driver.
        if (isTRUE(params$ar_rung_adequacy %||% TRUE) && length(ar_ladder) > 1)
          tryCatch(write_block_cv_diagnostics(fit_try, bss_data_try, days_ss,
                                              paste0(label, "_", bss_data_try$.ar_resolution %||% attempt),
                                              output_dir, prefix = "ladder_block"),
                   error = function(e) bss_warn("ladder", sprintf("%s attempt %d: the rung's block CV was not written (%s).",
                                                               label, attempt, conditionMessage(e)), severity = "note"))
        ar_escalation_log[[length(ar_escalation_log) + 1]] <- tibble(
          fit                 = label,
          attempt             = attempt,
          n_attempts_planned  = length(ar_ladder),
          ar_resolution       = bss_data_try$.ar_resolution %||% NA_character_,
          P_n                 = bss_data_try$P_n,
          escalation_enabled  = .esc_on,
          divergences         = gate_try$divergences         %||% NA_integer_,
          divergence_fraction = gate_try$divergence_fraction %||% NA_real_,
          impact_C_sd         = gate_try$impact_C_sd         %||% NA_real_,
          pass_convergence    = gate_try$pass_convergence    %||% NA,
          catch_median        = .rung$catch_median,
          catch_lo95          = .rung$catch_lo95,
          catch_hi95          = .rung$catch_hi95,
          pi_width            = .rung$pi_width,
          pi_width_rel        = .rung$pi_width_rel,
          effort_median       = .rung$effort_median,
          p_loo               = .radq$p_loo,
          p_loo_frac          = .radq$p_loo_frac,
          n_pareto_bad        = .radq$n_pareto_bad,
          cov50_gear          = .radq$cov50_gear,
          cov50_catch         = .radq$cov50_catch,
          cov50_trailer       = .radq$cov50_trailer,
          pit_mean_catch      = .radq$pit_mean_catch,
          selected            = FALSE
        )

        # Rung selection; see the fully commented block in the pooled driver. Default
        # "first_pass" reproduces the pre-2026-09-04 behaviour exactly.
        .stop_rule   <- params$ar_escalate_stop   %||% "first_pass"
        .select_rule <- params$ar_escalate_select %||% "first_pass"
        # 2026-09-28 (B46): a gate that ERRORS is a rung not shown to pass, so it escalates
        # (bounded by ar_escalate_max_attempts) instead of stopping the ladder as a pass.
        # The authoritative gate in the totals section recomputes the verdict either way.
        if (is.null(gate_try)) message(sprintf("  WARNING: %s attempt %d: the convergence gate errored; treated as NOT passed.", label, attempt))
        .passed      <- !is.null(gate_try) && isTRUE(gate_try$pass_convergence)
        .keep <- if (is.null(fit)) TRUE
                 else if (identical(.stop_rule, "first_pass")) TRUE
                 else if (!.passed) FALSE
                 else if (!isTRUE(.incumbent_passed)) TRUE
                 else if (identical(.select_rule, "narrowest_pi"))
                   isTRUE(.rung$pi_width_rel < (.incumbent_pi_rel %||% Inf))
                 else FALSE
        if (.keep) {
          bss_data <- bss_data_try; fit <- fit_try
          ar_resolutions[[label]] <- bss_data_try$.ar_resolution
          .kept_attempt[[label]] <- attempt
          .incumbent_passed <- .passed
          .incumbent_pi_rel <- .rung$pi_width_rel
        }

        if (identical(.stop_rule, "all_rungs") && .esc_on) {
          if (attempt < length(ar_ladder)) {
            message(sprintf("  [all_rungs] %s AR %s the gate; fitting %s next for the ladder.",
                            bss_data_try$.ar_resolution, if (.passed) "PASSED" else "failed",
                            ar_ladder[attempt + 1]))
            next
          } else break
        }

        if (.passed) break
        if (!.esc_on) break
        if (attempt < length(ar_ladder))
          message(sprintf("  Gate FAILED at %s AR; escalating to %s and refitting.",
                          bss_data_try$.ar_resolution, ar_ladder[attempt + 1]))
        else
          message("  Gate FAILED at the coarsest rung; this component will report the Point Estimator.")
      }

      if (too_thin) next

      # --- Extract and save BSS summary ---
      # C_sum_gear is the predictive season total per gear. With G = 1 it is a
      # single 'All' column and sum(C_sum_gear) == C_sum. The Dirichlet pi_gear
      # machinery described in older comments is not present in the Stan model.
      .gear_pars <- c("C_sum","C_expected_sum","E_sum","C_sum_gear","B1","B2",
                      "r_C_gear_out","sigma_eps_C_gear_out")
      # A36 (2026-10-16): the Sunday increment on the weekend effort effect, when the split is on.
      if (isTRUE(bss_data$sunday_split == 1L)) .gear_pars <- c(.gear_pars, "B1_sun_out")
      # A39 (2026-10-18): the per-day effort effect's SD, when the effect is on.
      if (isTRUE(bss_data$effort_day_effect == 1L)) .gear_pars <- c(.gear_pars, "sigma_uE_out")
      # improvement 4: opener effort covariates (labels in bss_data$.opener_labels).
      if (bss_data$K_open > 0) .gear_pars <- c(.gear_pars, "B_open_out")
      # improvement 8: the OSP crab-only lower bound alongside f itself.
      if (isTRUE(bss_data$osp_crab_lower == 1L)) .gear_pars <- c(.gear_pars, "f_lower_out")
      if (bss_data$apply_crab_fraction == 1L) .gear_pars <- c(.gear_pars, "f_crab_out")
      # review item 1B (2026-09-08): the dynamic-f scale parameters, when the walk is live.
      if (isTRUE(bss_data$crab_fraction_dynamic == 1L) && isTRUE(bss_data$crab_fraction_estimate == 1L)) {
        .gear_pars <- c(.gear_pars, "sigma_f_out", "cfi_kappa_out")
        # 2026-09-09: the combo-trip share walk, when typed contacts or an OSP stream feed it.
        if (isTRUE(bss_data$combo_dynamic == 1L)) .gear_pars <- c(.gear_pars, "combo_c_out", "sigma_c_out", "cfc_kappa_out")
        # D40 (2026-10-04): the volume slope and each stratum's boat-weighted share, which is
        # the share the totals apply when the day-level volume term is on.
        if (isTRUE(bss_data$f_volume == 1L)) .gear_pars <- c(.gear_pars, "beta_fvol_out", "f_crab_bw_out")
      }
      bss_summ <- summary(fit, pars = .gear_pars)$summary
      message("  BSS Summary:\n"); print(bss_summ)
      write.csv(as.data.frame(bss_summ), file.path(output_dir, paste0("bss_summary_",label,".csv")))

      # review item 1B: f by stratum, LABELLED and beside the data that informed it
      # (f_crab_out[k] alone is an index). Same file as the pooled track.
      .fs <- attr(bss_data, "f_strata")
      if (bss_data$apply_crab_fraction == 1L && is.data.frame(.fs)) {
        .fq <- summary(fit, pars = "f_crab_out")$summary
        .fs_out <- cbind(as.data.frame(.fs),
                         f_median = .fq[, "50%"], f_lo95 = .fq[, "2.5%"], f_hi95 = .fq[, "97.5%"],
                         f_n_eff = round(.fq[, "n_eff"]), f_Rhat = round(.fq[, "Rhat"], 4))
        # 2026-09-09: the combo-trip share c per stratum and the implied crab-only share
        # f(1 - c), which is what OSP's crabbing-only column should read.
        if (isTRUE(bss_data$combo_dynamic == 1L)) {
          .cq <- summary(fit, pars = "combo_c_out")$summary; .lq <- summary(fit, pars = "f_lower_out")$summary
          .fs_out <- cbind(.fs_out, c_median = .cq[, "50%"], c_lo95 = .cq[, "2.5%"], c_hi95 = .cq[, "97.5%"],
                           crab_only_share_median = .lq[, "50%"], crab_only_share_lo95 = .lq[, "2.5%"], crab_only_share_hi95 = .lq[, "97.5%"])
        }
        # D40: under the volume term f_median is the share at the stratum's CENTRAL volume;
        # f_bw is the boat-weighted share the totals apply, and crab_only_share_bw = f_bw x (1 - c)
        # is the figure to set beside OSP's own expansion of its crab-only counts.
        if (isTRUE(bss_data$f_volume == 1L) && isTRUE(bss_data$crab_fraction_estimate == 1L) && isTRUE(bss_data$crab_fraction_dynamic == 1L)) {
          .bq <- summary(fit, pars = "f_crab_bw_out")$summary
          .fs_out <- cbind(.fs_out, f_bw_median = .bq[, "50%"], f_bw_lo95 = .bq[, "2.5%"], f_bw_hi95 = .bq[, "97.5%"],
                           volume_centre = exp(as.numeric(bss_data$fvol_centre)))
          if (isTRUE(bss_data$combo_dynamic == 1L)) {
            .bd <- rstan::extract(fit, "f_crab_bw_out")[[1]] * (1 - rstan::extract(fit, "combo_c_out")[[1]])
            .fs_out <- cbind(.fs_out, crab_only_share_bw_median = apply(.bd, 2, stats::median),
                             crab_only_share_bw_lo95 = apply(.bd, 2, stats::quantile, 0.025),
                             crab_only_share_bw_hi95 = apply(.bd, 2, stats::quantile, 0.975))
          }
        }
        write.csv(.fs_out, file.path(output_dir, paste0("crab_fraction_strata_", label, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
      }

      # improvement 4: map B_open_out[i] to its opener name (Stan carries only the index).
      .olab <- strsplit(bss_data$.opener_labels %||% "", ",", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
      .olab <- .olab[nzchar(.olab)]
      if (length(.olab) > 0)
        write.csv(tibble(index = seq_along(.olab), parameter = sprintf("B_open_out[%d]", seq_along(.olab)),
                         opener = .olab),
                  file.path(output_dir, paste0("opener_covariates_", label, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)

      # 2026-09-28 (B44): the headline and every total are EXPECTED catch, as on the pooled
      # track. C_sum is the predictive total (a Poisson draw per day on top of the expected
      # catch); the gear driver used to sum it for the port total, so the cross-check compared
      # the pooled track's expected catch with this track's predictive catch.
      C_draws <- rstan::extract(fit, "C_sum")$C_sum                          # Stan's Poisson predictive (reconciliation only)
      C_exp_draws <- rstan::extract(fit, "C_expected_sum")$C_expected_sum  # expected (no noise)
      E_draws <- rstan::extract(fit, "E_sum")$E_sum
      # A38 (2026-10-16, D44): the fit's turnover draws, kept beside the totals so the port total can
      # pair this population's components comonotonically in tau_bar (bss_port_tau_coupling.R).
      tau_draws <- tryCatch(as.numeric(rstan::extract(fit, "tau_bar")$tau_bar[, 1]), error = function(e) NULL)
      # B46 (2026-09-28): the predictive total from the fitted observation model (party-level
      # ZINB, bss_predictive_catch.R), as on the pooled track.
      C_pred_draws <- tryCatch(bss_predictive_catch(fit, bss_data, bss_predictive_seed(params$bss_seed, label)),
                               error = function(e) { message("  predictive catch: ", conditionMessage(e)); NULL }) %||% C_draws

      C_gear_draws <- rstan::extract(fit, "C_sum_gear")$C_sum_gear  # [draws, G_gear]
      gear_labels <- bss_data$.gear_type_labels

      bss_all[[label]] <- list(
        C_sum = quantile(C_draws, c(0.025,0.5,0.975)),
        C_expected_sum = quantile(C_exp_draws, c(0.025,0.5,0.975)),
        E_sum = quantile(E_draws, c(0.025,0.5,0.975)),
        C_draws = C_draws, C_exp_draws = C_exp_draws, C_pred_draws = C_pred_draws, E_draws = E_draws, tau_draws = tau_draws,
        C_gear_draws = C_gear_draws,
        gear_type_labels = gear_labels,
        fit = fit, pe_fallback = FALSE,
        # Carried for the shared diagnostics in 03_R_functions (PPC, effort
        # overdispersion decomposition, O1-O13, PSIS-LOO). Without these the
        # writers silently skip, so they are stored on the fit entry.
        bss_data = bss_data, days_ss = days_ss,
        population = pop, subseason = ss$name, catch_group = cg
      )

      # --- BSS PLOTS for this fit ---

      # Daily effort posteriors (ribbon plot)
      E_bss <- rstan::extract(fit, "E")$E  # [draws, S, D, G]
      E_daily <- tibble(
        event_date = days_ss$event_date,
        median = apply(E_bss[,1,,1], 2, median),
        lo95 = apply(E_bss[,1,,1], 2, quantile, 0.025),
        hi95 = apply(E_bss[,1,,1], 2, quantile, 0.975)
      )

      p_bss_eff <- E_daily |>
        left_join(days_ss |> select(event_date, day_type), by = "event_date") |>
        ggplot(aes(x = event_date)) +
        geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lo95, ymax = hi95), alpha = 0.2, fill = "steelblue") +
        geom_line(aes(y = median), color = "steelblue") +
        labs(title = sprintf("BSS Daily Effort: %s", label),
             subtitle = "Median with 95% credible interval",
             x = "Date", y = "Effort (gear-deployments)") +
        theme_bw()
      ggsave(file.path(output_dir, paste0("plot_bss_effort_", label, ".png")),
             p_bss_eff, width = 10, height = 6)
      print(p_bss_eff)

      # Daily catch posteriors
      # v5.2: C_total is now the expected value (smooth trajectory, no Poisson noise).
      # Uses C_total for trajectory plots; the season total is C_expected_sum (B44).
      C_total_bss <- rstan::extract(fit, "C_total")$C_total  # [draws, D]
      C_daily <- tibble(
        event_date = days_ss$event_date,
        median = apply(C_total_bss, 2, median),
        lo95 = apply(C_total_bss, 2, quantile, 0.025),
        hi95 = apply(C_total_bss, 2, quantile, 0.975)
      )

      p_bss_catch <- C_daily |>
        ggplot(aes(x = event_date)) +
        geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lo95, ymax = hi95), alpha = 0.2, fill = "darkgreen") +
        geom_line(aes(y = median), color = "darkgreen") +
        labs(title = sprintf("BSS Daily Catch (%s): %s", cg, label),
             subtitle = "Median with 95% credible interval",
             x = "Date", y = "Dungeness crab caught") +
        theme_bw()
      ggsave(file.path(output_dir, paste0("plot_bss_catch_", label, ".png")),
             p_bss_catch, width = 10, height = 6)
      print(p_bss_catch)

      # Season total posterior densities
      p_bss_post <- tibble(C_expected_sum = C_exp_draws, E_sum = E_draws) |>
        pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "param", values_to = "value") |>
        ggplot(aes(x = value)) +
        geom_density(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.4) +
        facet_wrap(~param, scales = "free", labeller = labeller(
          param = c(C_expected_sum = paste("Expected catch", cg), E_sum = "Effort (gear-deployments)")
        )) +
        labs(title = sprintf("BSS Posteriors: %s", label), x = "Value", y = "Density") +
        theme_bw()
      ggsave(file.path(output_dir, paste0("plot_bss_posteriors_", label, ".png")),
             p_bss_post, width = 12, height = 5)
      print(p_bss_post)

      # Save daily CSVs
      write.csv(E_daily, file.path(output_dir, paste0("bss_daily_effort_", label, ".csv")), row.names=FALSE)
      write.csv(C_daily, file.path(output_dir, paste0("bss_daily_catch_", label, ".csv")), row.names=FALSE)

    }
  }
}

timer_stop("5_BSS_model_runs")

# improvement 7: persist the ladder (one row per attempt, with the gate verdict that
# decided whether to escalate).
ar_escalation_df <- if (length(ar_escalation_log)) bind_rows(ar_escalation_log) else NULL
# 2026-09-04: mark the rung whose fit was actually kept. This track wrote `selected` as a
# column of FALSE and never set it, so its ar_escalation_log.csv could not answer the one
# question the file exists to answer. Same rule as the pooled driver: match on the recorded
# attempt index, never on the resolution string.
if (!is.null(ar_escalation_df) && nrow(ar_escalation_df)) {
  for (.lb in unique(ar_escalation_df$fit)) {
    .ka <- .kept_attempt[[.lb]] %||% NA_integer_
    .i <- if (!is.na(.ka)) which(ar_escalation_df$fit == .lb & ar_escalation_df$attempt == .ka) else integer(0)
    if (length(.i)) ar_escalation_df$selected[.i] <- TRUE
  }
}
if (!is.null(ar_escalation_df))
  write.csv(ar_escalation_df, file.path(output_dir, "ar_escalation_log.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

5. Convergence gate and model selection

The scale-aware gate decides, per fit, whether to report the Bayesian posterior or fall back to the PE. A fit passes only if R-hat is below 1.01, effective sample size is above 400, the divergent fraction is under the backstop, and the divergent draws do not move the reported totals by more than 0.10 posterior standard deviations. If a component reads PE here, its Bayesian fit did not clear the gate; that is expected for data-thin components and is not an error.

# ---- 7.6b CONVERGENCE GATE (B1.8, scale-aware; shared in 03_R_functions) ----
# Decide PE-vs-BSS per fit BEFORE any reported total is assembled. bss_compute_gate
# and bss_use_pe_for live in 03_R_functions/bss_convergence_gate.R (shared with the
# pooled track). A fit reports BSS only if it passes the gate; otherwise the
# reported-estimate sections below fall back to PE. Diagnostic sections still key
# off pe_fallback so a fitted-but-gate-failed component keeps its per-fit outputs.
message("\n", strrep("=",60), "\n CONVERGENCE GATE\n", strrep("=",60), "\n")
for(label in names(bss_all)) {
  gi <- bss_compute_gate(
    bss_all[[label]], label,
    catch_par        = "C_expected_sum",
    effort_par       = "E_sum",
    max_impact_sd    = params$max_divergence_total_impact_sd %||% 0.10,
    max_div_fraction = params$max_divergence_fraction %||% 0.05,
    ar_resolution    = ar_resolutions[[label]] %||% NA_character_
  )
  bss_all[[label]]$gate_info <- gi
  bss_all[[label]]$use_bss   <- isTRUE(gi$pass_convergence)
}
##   shore_ring_net_only_Dungeness_Kept: 35/8000 divergent (0.4%); impact C/E = 0.0013/0.0002 SD; level-distortion C/E = 3.2%/4.9%
##   shore_all_gear_Dungeness_Kept: 4/8000 divergent (0.1%); impact C/E = 0.0000/0.0000 SD; level-distortion C/E = 4.1%/3.8%

6. Headline result: port total

The season harvest estimate: the sum of all components, reported as expected catch with a 95 percent credible interval. This is the number to cite, read together with the convergence and PE-vs-BSS sections. Components that passed the gate contribute their Bayesian posterior; components that did not contribute their PE point. Cross-check: the port total and the boat should land within a few percent of the pooled CPUE model’s run.

# ---- 7.7 COMBINED BSS PORT TOTAL ----
timer_start("6_outputs")
message("\n", strrep("=",60), "\n COMBINED RESULTS\n", strrep("=",60), "\n")
# A38 (2026-10-16, closes D44): pair each listed population's components comonotonically in tau_bar
# before anything sums draws across components, so the shared prior centre of their turnover is
# carried as shared (bss_port_tau_coupling.R; port_tau_coupling = "none" leaves the pairing as it
# was, bit for bit). The re-indexed components carry draw_perm, which the monthly block applies.
bss_all <- bss_couple_component_draws(bss_all, params)
##   Port total pairing (A38, port_tau_coupling = comonotone): shore_ring_net_only_Dungeness_Kept re-indexed to shore_all_gear_Dungeness_Kept's tau_bar quantiles.
n_draws_max <- max(sapply(bss_all, function(b) {
  if(bss_use_pe_for(b)) return(0)   # B1.8: a gate-failed fit contributes no BSS draws
  length(b$C_exp_draws)
}))
if(n_draws_max == 0) n_draws_max <- params$bss_chains * (params$bss_iter_default - params$bss_warmup_default)

# D22 (2), 2026-10-19 (B73), as the pooled driver: a PE-reported component enters the port draws
# as seeded lognormal draws around its PE point with CV = its PE catch SE / point (the effort with
# its effort SE), one set per component and catch group shared by every section that sums
# components; a results object without an SE enters as the constant it was. Bit-identical when
# every component reports BSS.
.pe_fallback_cache <- list()
.pe_fallback_draws <- function(pe_label, cg) {
  key <- paste(pe_label, cg)
  if (!is.null(.pe_fallback_cache[[key]])) return(.pe_fallback_cache[[key]])
  x <- pe_all[[pe_label]]; pt <- x[[cg]] %||% 0; ef <- x$effort_total %||% 0
  se_c <- if (identical(cg, "Dungeness_Kept")) x$catch_se %||% NA_real_ else NA_real_
  se_e <- x$effort_se %||% NA_real_
  ln <- function(point, se, k) {
    if (!is.finite(point) || point <= 0 || !is.finite(se) || se <= 0) return(rep(point, n_draws_max))
    sdlog <- sqrt(log(1 + (se / point)^2))
    point * bss_with_seed((params$bss_seed %||% 1L) + 9000L + k, exp(stats::rnorm(n_draws_max, -sdlog^2 / 2, sdlog)))
  }
  k <- length(.pe_fallback_cache)
  out <- list(C = ln(pt, se_c, 2L * k + 1L), E = ln(ef, se_e, 2L * k + 2L))
  .pe_fallback_cache[[key]] <<- out
  out
}
.pe_port_se <- function(field, census_field = NULL) {   # B73: the PE's own SE beside its point in port_total_*.csv
  v <- unlist(lapply(setdiff(names(pe_all), "comm_charter"), function(k) pe_all[[k]][[field]] %||% NA_real_))
  if (!is.null(census_field)) v <- c(v, pe_all$comm_charter[[census_field]] %||% NA_real_)
  sqrt(sum(as.numeric(v)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
}

.cc_draws_by_cg <- list()   # 2026-09-28 (B46): the census draws, kept for the season totals below
for(cg in bss_catch_groups) {
  bss_C_total <- rep(0, n_draws_max)       # expected catch (the headline, as on the pooled track)
  bss_C_pred_total <- rep(0, n_draws_max)  # predictive catch
  bss_E_total <- rep(0, n_draws_max)

  for(pop in c("shore","private_boat")) {
    for(ss in subseasons) {
      label <- paste0(pop, "_", ss$name, "_", cg)
      pe_label <- paste0(pop, "_", ss$name)
      b <- bss_all[[label]]

      if(bss_use_pe_for(b)) {   # B1.8: PE if insufficient data OR failed the gate
        .pd <- .pe_fallback_draws(pe_label, cg)   # D22 (2), B73: with its PE SE, not a constant
        bss_C_total <- bss_C_total + .pd$C
        bss_C_pred_total <- bss_C_pred_total + .pd$C
        bss_E_total <- bss_E_total + .pd$E
      } else {
        n <- length(b$C_exp_draws)
        idx <- rep_len(1:n, n_draws_max)
        bss_C_total <- bss_C_total + b$C_exp_draws[idx]
        bss_C_pred_total <- bss_C_pred_total + (b$C_pred_draws %||% b$C_draws)[idx]
        bss_E_total <- bss_E_total + b$E_draws[idx]
      }
    }
  }
  # Review item 4 (2026-09-08/09), split in two on 2026-09-11: the commercial part is a
  # census (a constant), the charter part an expansion. carried_se is what enters the port
  # interval; census_uncertainty selects it ("charter" ships). Draws are clamped at
  # observed_dung (the commercial census plus the charter crab actually observed).
  .cc <- pe_all$comm_charter
  .cc_draws <- rep(.cc[[cg]] %||% 0, n_draws_max)
  if (cg == "Dungeness_Kept" && is.finite(.cc$carried_se %||% NA) && (.cc$carried_se %||% 0) > 0) {
    # 2026-09-26 (B38): a reproducible port total; B46 (2026-09-28): the caller's RNG restored.
    .cc_draws <- bss_with_seed(params$bss_seed %||% 1L, pmax(rnorm(n_draws_max, .cc$Dungeness_Kept, .cc$carried_se), .cc$observed_dung %||% 0))
    message(sprintf(paste0("  Census enters the port interval with SE %s under census_uncertainty = '%s' (total SE %s: charter expansion %s, ",
                           "commercial per-vessel mean %s; census_expansion = '%s', %d unsampled calendar days)."),
                    format(round(.cc$carried_se), big.mark = ","), .cc$census_uncertainty %||% "charter",
                    format(round(.cc$Dungeness_Kept_se %||% 0), big.mark = ","), format(round(.cc$charter_se %||% 0), big.mark = ","),
                    format(round(.cc$commercial_se %||% 0), big.mark = ","), .cc$census_expansion %||% "none", sum(!.cc$daily_full$observed)))
  }
  bss_C_total <- bss_C_total + .cc_draws
  bss_C_pred_total <- bss_C_pred_total + .cc_draws
  bss_E_total <- bss_E_total + pe_all$comm_charter$effort_total
  .cc_draws_by_cg[[cg]] <- .cc_draws

  # 2026-09-28 (B44): the same rows, labels and quantity as the pooled track's
  # port_total_*.csv (Effort, Expected_Catch, Predictive_Catch), so the cross-check reads
  # like for like. Effort is gear-deployments on both tracks.
  final_table <- tibble(
    Catch_Group = cg,
    Estimate = c("Effort", "Expected_Catch", "Predictive_Catch"),
    PE = c(round(pe_port_total("effort_total")),
           round(pe_port_total(cg)),
           NA),
    PE_se = c(round(.pe_port_se("effort_se")), if (identical(cg, "Dungeness_Kept")) round(.pe_port_se("catch_se", "carried_se")) else NA, NA),   # D22 (2), B73
    BSS_median = c(round(median(bss_E_total)), round(median(bss_C_total)), round(median(bss_C_pred_total))),
    BSS_lo95 = c(round(quantile(bss_E_total,0.025)), round(quantile(bss_C_total,0.025)), round(quantile(bss_C_pred_total,0.025))),
    BSS_hi95 = c(round(quantile(bss_E_total,0.975)), round(quantile(bss_C_total,0.975)), round(quantile(bss_C_pred_total,0.975)))
    ,
    # F5: this column is NOT pure BSS. It is the gate-selected combination:
    # BSS draws where the convergence gate passed, PE where it failed or data
    # were insufficient, and the commercial/charter census. As of v5.5 both shore
    # and boat effort are on gear-deployments, so the Effort row is a single unit.
    composition = "BSS where gate passed; PE otherwise; census for comm/charter",
    effort_units_note = "Effort row is gear-deployments for both shore and boat (v5.5+)"
  )

  message(sprintf("\n--- Port Total: %s ---\n", cg))
  write.csv(final_table, file.path(output_dir, paste0("port_total_",cg,".csv")), row.names=FALSE)
  if (cg == "Dungeness_Kept") {
    .port_total_disp  <- final_table
    .tau_port_draws   <- bss_C_total   # combined port catch draws (for the tau diagnostic)
  }
}
# Headline table as a clean captioned table (auto-printed at chunk top level).
if (exists(".port_total_disp")) report_table(.port_total_disp,
  caption = "Port total: PE, BSS median, and 95% credible interval (combined effort and catch)")

6a. Season totals

Per-season totals, written to season_totals.csv every run (and shown here when the run spans more than one season). Since 2026-09-28 (B46) the gear track writes them too, from the same code as the pooled track.

Port interval under the shipped pairing (port_tau_coupling = comonotone): 47,365 [39,252, 59,359], SD 5,156; under the independent pairing: 47,337 [39,599, 59,148], SD 5,016.

6b. Boat tau_boat prior sensitivity (optional)

The boat harvest is proportional to the boat deployment turnover tau_boat whenever no in-window boat ingress/egress days pin it (as on the 2024-25 development season, with 0 boat I/E days; the count for this run’s fit is used below), so the boat total rests on the tau_boat prior (GR-12). With run_config$diagnose_tau_sensitivity = TRUE this section projects the boat and port totals across a grid of tau_boat prior means in a single run (no refit), and states whether the projection is exact (tau prior-dominated) or an upper bound. For the exact multi-refit check, source 06_diagnostics/run_tau_sweep.R. Healthy: if the boat scales ~linearly with tau_boat, the boat is prior-driven and the field priority is boat I/E (egress-classification) coverage; if it barely moves, tau is data-identified and the prior is not the lever.

if (isTRUE(params$diagnose_tau_sensitivity)) {
  # 2026-09-28 (B46): every private-boat ALL-GEAR sub-season, found from the sub-season list
  # (a multi-season span names them all_gear_<season>; the key was hard-coded to the scalar
  # "all_gear"), and the boat I/E day count read from the fit's own Stan data (IE_n; it was
  # read from an n_ie_obs field no fit entry carries, so it was always 0).
  .boat_keys <- paste0("private_boat_", vapply(Filter(function(z) identical(z$gear_regime %||% "all_gear", "all_gear"),
                                                        subseasons), function(z) z$name, character(1)), "_Dungeness_Kept")
  .ran <- FALSE
  for (boat_key in .boat_keys) {
  b_boat   <- bss_all[[boat_key]]
  if (!is.null(b_boat) && !bss_use_pe_for(b_boat) && exists(".tau_port_draws")) {
    .ran <- TRUE
    if (length(.boat_keys) > 1) cat(sprintf("\n**%s**\n\n", boat_key))
    n_draws_max <- length(.tau_port_draws)
    nb          <- length(b_boat$C_exp_draws)
    # Boat's aligned contribution to the port draws (same alignment and the same expected
    # catch as sec 6), so the projection swaps only the boat term.
    boat_draws  <- b_boat$C_exp_draws[rep_len(1:nb, n_draws_max)]
    n_ie_boat   <- as.integer(b_boat$bss_data$IE_n %||% 0L)
    tau_sens <- diagnose_tau_boat_sensitivity(
      boat = b_boat, port_C_draws = .tau_port_draws, boat_C_draws = boat_draws,
      params = params, n_ie_boat = n_ie_boat, output_dir = output_dir)
    if (!is.null(tau_sens$table)) {
      cat(paste(knitr::kable(
        tau_sens$table |> dplyr::select(tau_boat_prior_mu, boat_catch_median,
          boat_lo95, boat_hi95, boat_pct_change, port_total_median, port_pct_change),
        caption = sprintf("Projected boat and port totals across the tau_boat prior grid (%s).", boat_key),
        format.args = list(big.mark = ",")), collapse = "\n"), "\n\n")
      cat("*", tau_sens$note, "*\n\n", sep = "")
    } else {
      cat("_", tau_sens$note, "_\n\n", sep = "")
    }
  }
  }
  if (!.ran)
    cat("_Boat tau sensitivity not applicable (every boat all-gear fit used the PE fallback, or no port draws were stashed)._\n\n")
} else {
  cat("_Set `diagnose_tau_sensitivity = TRUE` in run_config.R to project the boat and port sensitivity to the `tau_boat` prior (single run, no refit). Writes `tau_boat_sensitivity.csv`._\n\n")
}

7. Monthly estimates

The season total broken out by month, with per-month credible intervals, showing the within-season trajectory. Healthy: the widest intervals fall on the thinly sampled summer months, where the process model imputes the most.

# ===========================================================================
# 7.8 MONTHLY ESTIMATES WITH UNCERTAINTY
# v5.1: Uses C_total (vector[D]) instead of C[S][D,G]
# ===========================================================================

message("\n", strrep("=",60), "\n MONTHLY ESTIMATES\n", strrep("=",60), "\n")
days_full <- prep_days_crab(params$est_date_start, params$est_date_end,
                            params, L_eff_model)

month_lookup <- days_full |>
  mutate(month_label = format(event_date, "%Y-%m")) |>
  select(event_date, month_label)

all_months <- sort(unique(month_lookup$month_label))
monthly_C_draws <- matrix(0, nrow = n_draws_max, ncol = length(all_months),
                          dimnames = list(NULL, all_months))
monthly_E_draws <- matrix(0, nrow = n_draws_max, ncol = length(all_months),
                          dimnames = list(NULL, all_months))

for(cg in bss_catch_groups) {
  for(pop in c("shore","private_boat")) {
    for(ss in subseasons) {
      label <- paste0(pop, "_", ss$name, "_", cg)
      pe_label <- paste0(pop, "_", ss$name)
      b <- bss_all[[label]]

      days_ss <- prep_days_crab(ss$start, ss$end, params, L_eff_model)
      days_ss$month_label <- format(days_ss$event_date, "%Y-%m")

      if(bss_use_pe_for(b)) {   # B1.8: PE if insufficient data OR failed the gate
        # B44 (2026-09-28): the PE's own strata, spread over their calendar days and summed
        # by month (pe_monthly_split.R). The months add up to the component totals exactly
        # and carry each cell's own CPUE; the effort-share split this replaced assumed one
        # CPUE for the whole sub-season and weighted months by their sampled days only.
        monthly_pe <- pe_monthly_split(pe_all[[pe_label]], days_ss, cg)

        for(m in monthly_pe$month_label) {
          if(m %in% all_months) {
            i_m <- monthly_pe$month_label == m
            monthly_C_draws[, m] <- monthly_C_draws[, m] + monthly_pe$month_catch[i_m]
            monthly_E_draws[, m] <- monthly_E_draws[, m] + monthly_pe$month_effort[i_m]
          }
        }

      } else {
        # 2026-09-28 (B44): EXPECTED daily catch (C_total, no Poisson noise), as the pooled
        # track's monthly block uses C_expected, so the monthly figures sum to the port
        # total's quantity. (This used C_gear_pred, the predictive daily catch.)
        C_daily_mat <- rstan::extract(b$fit, "C_total")$C_total  # [draws, D]
        E_bss <- rstan::extract(b$fit, "E")$E  # [draws, S, D, G]
        E_daily_mat <- E_bss[,1,,1]
        n_fit_draws <- nrow(C_daily_mat)

        for(m in unique(days_ss$month_label)) {
          day_idx <- which(days_ss$month_label == m)
          if(length(day_idx) == 0) next

          if(length(day_idx) == 1) {
            month_C <- C_daily_mat[, day_idx]
            month_E <- E_daily_mat[, day_idx]
          } else {
            month_C <- rowSums(C_daily_mat[, day_idx])
            month_E <- rowSums(E_daily_mat[, day_idx])
          }

          idx <- rep_len(b$draw_perm %||% seq_len(n_fit_draws), n_draws_max)   # A38 (2026-10-16): the port total's pairing (bss_port_tau_coupling.R)
          if(m %in% all_months) {
            monthly_C_draws[, m] <- monthly_C_draws[, m] + month_C[idx]
            monthly_E_draws[, m] <- monthly_E_draws[, m] + month_E[idx]
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

# Add commercial/charter to census months
if(!is.null(pe_all$comm_charter$daily_est)) {
  comm_daily <- pe_all$comm_charter$daily_est |>
    mutate(month_label = format(date, "%Y-%m"))

  comm_total <- pe_all$comm_charter$Dungeness_Kept
  total_sampled_dung <- sum(comm_daily$est_dung)
  if(total_sampled_dung > 0) {
    for(m in unique(comm_daily$month_label)) {
      if(m %in% all_months) {
        share <- sum(comm_daily$est_dung[comm_daily$month_label == m]) / total_sampled_dung
        monthly_C_draws[, m] <- monthly_C_draws[, m] + comm_total * share
      }
    }
  }
}

monthly_summary <- tibble(
  Month = all_months,
  BSS_Catch_median = apply(monthly_C_draws, 2, median),
  BSS_Catch_lo95   = apply(monthly_C_draws, 2, quantile, 0.025),
  BSS_Catch_hi95   = apply(monthly_C_draws, 2, quantile, 0.975),
  BSS_Effort_median = apply(monthly_E_draws, 2, median),
  BSS_Effort_lo95   = apply(monthly_E_draws, 2, quantile, 0.025),
  BSS_Effort_hi95   = apply(monthly_E_draws, 2, quantile, 0.975)
) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), round))

message("\n--- Monthly Dungeness Catch Estimates (all populations combined) ---\n")
report_table(monthly_summary |> select(Month, BSS_Catch_median, BSS_Catch_lo95, BSS_Catch_hi95), caption = "Monthly Dungeness catch (all populations combined)")

9. Catch by gear type

Catch attributed to each gear type. GR-7 status: when gear_resolved_G = TRUE (Phase 1), the shore fits carry a genuine per-gear CPUE posterior (Pot / Ring Net / Trap / Snare / Mixed), so those rows are real BSS estimates with credible intervals; the boat stays pooled (G = 1, one “All” row, since Phase 0 showed it is Pot-dominated) and commercial/charter Pot enters by census. Single-gear interviews feed each gear’s CPUE; multi-gear trips form the “Mixed” row (~33% of shore all-gear catch, the honest ceiling until sampling shifts toward single-gear reporting). When the toggle is OFF every fit is G = 1 and the split is PE-apportioned (retained for continuity, not for citation). The per-gear catches reconcile to each population’s all-gear total by construction (checked immediately below).

# ===========================================================================
# 7.10 BSS CATCH BY GEAR TYPE
# v5.1: PE fallback uses word-boundary regex consistent with BSS
# ===========================================================================

message("\n", strrep("=",60), "\n BSS CATCH BY GEAR TYPE\n", strrep("=",60), "\n")
gear_results <- list()

for(pop in c("shore","private_boat")) {
  for(ss in subseasons) {
    label_cg <- paste0(pop, "_", ss$name, "_Dungeness_Kept")
    pe_label <- paste0(pop, "_", ss$name)
    b <- bss_all[[label_cg]]

    if(is.null(b)) next

    if(bss_use_pe_for(b)) {   # B1.8: PE if insufficient data OR failed the gate
      pe_catch_total <- pe_all[[pe_label]]$Dungeness_Kept %||% 0
      # v5.1: Word-boundary regex consistent with BSS classification
      int_ss <- dwg$interview |>
        filter(population == pop,
               between(event_date, ss$start, ss$end),
               dungeness_kept > 0) |>
        mutate(
          has_pot      = as.integer(str_detect(gear_type, "(?i)\\bpot\\b") &
                                    !str_detect(gear_type, "(?i)\\bslip\\s*ring\\b")),
          has_ring_net = as.integer(str_detect(gear_type, "(?i)\\bring\\s*net\\b")),
          has_trap     = as.integer(str_detect(gear_type, "(?i)\\b(trap|star)\\b")),
          has_snare    = as.integer(str_detect(gear_type, "(?i)\\bsnare\\b"))
        )
      # Apply regulatory exclusion consistent with BSS
      gear_exclude_ss <- ss$gear_exclude %||% character(0)
      if(length(gear_exclude_ss) > 0) {
        excl_cols <- c(Pot="has_pot", `Ring Net`="has_ring_net",
                       Trap="has_trap", Snare="has_snare")
        for(gt in gear_exclude_ss) {
          if(gt %in% names(excl_cols)) int_ss[[excl_cols[gt]]] <- 0L
        }
      }
      int_ss <- int_ss |>
        mutate(n_types = pmax(has_pot + has_ring_net + has_trap + has_snare, 1L))
      # Weighted allocation of catch across gear types
      gear_catch_alloc <- c(
        Pot = sum(int_ss$dungeness_kept * int_ss$has_pot / int_ss$n_types),
        `Ring Net` = sum(int_ss$dungeness_kept * int_ss$has_ring_net / int_ss$n_types),
        Trap = sum(int_ss$dungeness_kept * int_ss$has_trap / int_ss$n_types),
        Snare = sum(int_ss$dungeness_kept * int_ss$has_snare / int_ss$n_types)
      )
      gear_catch_alloc <- gear_catch_alloc[gear_catch_alloc > 0]
      total_alloc <- sum(gear_catch_alloc)
      if(total_alloc > 0) {
        props <- gear_catch_alloc / total_alloc
      } else {
        props <- c(Other = 1.0)
      }
      for(gt in names(props)) {
        gear_results[[length(gear_results)+1]] <- tibble(
          population=pop, subseason=ss$name, gear_type=gt,
          BSS_median=NA, BSS_lo95=NA, BSS_hi95=NA,
          PE_catch=round(pe_catch_total * props[gt]),
          method="PE (weighted proportional)"
        )
      }
    } else {
      labels <- b$gear_type_labels
      draws <- b$C_gear_draws
      for(gg in seq_along(labels)) {
        g_draws <- if(is.matrix(draws)) draws[,gg] else draws
        gear_results[[length(gear_results)+1]] <- tibble(
          population=pop, subseason=ss$name, gear_type=labels[gg],
          BSS_median=round(median(g_draws)),
          BSS_lo95=round(quantile(g_draws, 0.025)),
          BSS_hi95=round(quantile(g_draws, 0.975)),
          PE_catch=NA, method="BSS"
        )
      }
    }
  }
}

# Add commercial/charter as Pot
comm_catch <- pe_all$comm_charter$Dungeness_Kept %||% 0
gear_results[[length(gear_results)+1]] <- tibble(
  population="comm_charter", subseason="census", gear_type="Pot",
  BSS_median=NA, BSS_lo95=NA, BSS_hi95=NA,
  PE_catch=round(comm_catch),
  # B46 (2026-09-28): the label follows census_expansion (the shipped "none" is an exact
  # commercial census plus the charter roster expansion, not a day-type stratification)
  method = if (identical(params$census_expansion %||% "none", "none")) "Commercial census + charter expansion" else "Census (day-type stratified)"
)

# GR-7 reconciliation gate: per-gear BSS catches must sum to each population's all-gear
# total (identical draws in the Stan generated quantities). max_abs_draw_diff ~ 0 = valid.
reco_rows <- list()
for (pop in c("shore","private_boat")) for (ss in subseasons) {
  b <- bss_all[[paste0(pop, "_", ss$name, "_Dungeness_Kept")]]
  if (is.null(b) || bss_use_pe_for(b) || is.null(b$C_gear_draws)) next
  if (is.matrix(b$C_gear_draws) && ncol(b$C_gear_draws) > 1) {
    reco_rows[[length(reco_rows)+1]] <- tibble(
      fit = short_fit(paste0(pop, "_", ss$name, "_Dungeness_Kept")),
      G = ncol(b$C_gear_draws),
      C_sum_median = round(median(b$C_draws)),
      sum_gear_median = round(median(rowSums(b$C_gear_draws))),
      max_abs_draw_diff = signif(max(abs(rowSums(b$C_gear_draws) - b$C_draws)), 3))
  }
}
if (length(reco_rows) > 0) report_table(bind_rows(reco_rows),
  caption = "GR-7 reconciliation: per-gear catches sum to the all-gear total (max_abs_draw_diff ~ 0 = valid).")

# Port-level summary by gear type
gear_port <- gear_df |>
  mutate(best_catch = coalesce(BSS_median, PE_catch)) |>
  group_by(gear_type) |>
  summarise(

    has_BSS = any(method == "BSS"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(catch)) |>
  mutate(proportion = round(catch / sum(catch), 3))

10. Convergence report

The per-fit diagnostic table behind the gate decision: R-hat and effective sample size for the summed effort and catch, the worst per-gear-type R-hat, the divergent fraction, and the pass/fail flag. Healthy: pass_convergence TRUE with R-hat near 1.00 and effective sample size well above 400 on every fit that had sufficient data.

# ===========================================================================
# 7.11 CONVERGENCE REPORT
#
# v5.1: Extended diagnostics - checks C_sum_gear, r_C_gear, sigma_eps_C_gear
#        in addition to C_sum and E_sum (Issue 11)
# v5.2: Divergent transitions now included in pass/fail criterion.
#        Treedepth exceedance warnings added.
# ===========================================================================

message("\n", strrep("=",60), "\n CONVERGENCE REPORT\n", strrep("=",60), "\n")
convergence_report <- list()
for(label in names(bss_all)) {
  b <- bss_all[[label]]
  if(!is.null(b$pe_fallback) && b$pe_fallback) {
    convergence_report[[label]] <- tibble(
      fit = label, divergences = NA, treedepth_pct = NA,
      C_sum_rhat = NA, E_sum_rhat = NA, C_sum_neff = NA, E_sum_neff = NA,
      max_gear_rhat = NA, min_gear_neff = NA,
      max_r_C_rhat = NA, max_sigma_C_rhat = NA,
      pass_convergence = FALSE, method_selected = "PE (insufficient data)"
    )
  } else {
    sp <- rstan::get_sampler_params(b$fit, inc_warmup = FALSE)
    n_divergent <- sum(sapply(sp, function(x) sum(x[,"divergent__"])))
    n_treedepth <- sum(sapply(sp, function(x) sum(x[,"treedepth__"] >=
      b$fit@stan_args[[1]]$control$max_treedepth)))
    n_total <- sum(sapply(sp, nrow))

    # Core diagnostics: C_sum and E_sum
    summ_core <- summary(b$fit, pars = c("C_sum","E_sum"))$summary
    rhat_C <- summ_core["C_sum","Rhat"]; rhat_E <- summ_core["E_sum","Rhat"]
    neff_C <- summ_core["C_sum","n_eff"]; neff_E <- summ_core["E_sum","n_eff"]

    # v5.1 Extended: Per-gear-type diagnostics
    summ_gear <- summary(b$fit, pars = "C_sum_gear")$summary
    summ_r_C <- summary(b$fit, pars = "r_C_gear_out")$summary
    summ_sig_C <- summary(b$fit, pars = "sigma_eps_C_gear_out")$summary

    max_gear_rhat <- max(summ_gear[,"Rhat"], na.rm=TRUE)
    min_gear_neff <- min(summ_gear[,"n_eff"], na.rm=TRUE)
    max_r_C_rhat <- max(summ_r_C[,"Rhat"], na.rm=TRUE)
    max_sigma_C_rhat <- max(summ_sig_C[,"Rhat"], na.rm=TRUE)

    # Convergence criteria: ALL monitored parameters must pass
    all_rhats <- c(rhat_C, rhat_E, summ_gear[,"Rhat"],
                   summ_r_C[,"Rhat"], summ_sig_C[,"Rhat"])
    all_neffs <- c(neff_C, neff_E, summ_gear[,"n_eff"])

    pass_rhat <- max(all_rhats, na.rm=TRUE) < 1.01  # v5.4: tightened from 1.05 (Vehtari et al. 2021)
    pass_neff <- min(all_neffs, na.rm=TRUE) > 400
    # B1.8: the PE/BSS decision is the scale-aware gate (bss_compute_gate),
    # already computed and stored on the fit. Use it here so the report's
    # pass_convergence / method_selected match what actually selected PE vs BSS.
    # The gear-type diagnostics above are retained for insight; the divergence
    # fraction and impact values that drove the decision are printed to the
    # console by the gate and stored in b$gate_info.
    gi <- b$gate_info
    pass <- isTRUE(gi$pass_convergence)

    # v5.2: Warn on treedepth exceedances
    if(n_treedepth / n_total > 0.05) {
      message(sprintf("  WARNING: %s - %.1f%% treedepth exceedances (consider increasing max_treedepth)\n",
                  label, n_treedepth / n_total * 100))
    }
    # v5.2: Warn on divergences even if within threshold
    if(n_divergent > 0) {
      message(sprintf("  WARNING: %s - %d divergent transitions detected\n", label, n_divergent))
    }

    convergence_report[[label]] <- tibble(
      fit = label,
      divergences = n_divergent,
      treedepth_pct = round(n_treedepth / n_total * 100, 1),
      C_sum_rhat = round(rhat_C, 4),
      E_sum_rhat = round(rhat_E, 4),
      C_sum_neff = round(neff_C),
      E_sum_neff = round(neff_E),
      max_gear_rhat = round(max_gear_rhat, 4),
      min_gear_neff = round(min_gear_neff),
      max_r_C_rhat = round(max_r_C_rhat, 4),
      max_sigma_C_rhat = round(max_sigma_C_rhat, 4),
      pass_convergence = pass,
      method_selected = if(pass) "BSS" else "PE (convergence fail)"
    )

    # Warn if gear-type parameters failed but aggregates passed
    if(!pass && max(c(rhat_C, rhat_E), na.rm=TRUE) < 1.01) {
      message(sprintf("  WARNING: %s - C_sum/E_sum converged but gear-type parameters did not.\n", label))
      message(sprintf("    max gear Rhat=%.3f, max r_C Rhat=%.3f, max sigma_C Rhat=%.3f\n",
                  max_gear_rhat, max_r_C_rhat, max_sigma_C_rhat))
    }
  }
}
convergence_df <- bind_rows(convergence_report)

# F5: the scale-aware gate computed divergence_fraction, impact_C_sd, impact_E_sd
# and the four pass_* flags into b$gate_info, but the report above only carried
# `pass` and `method_selected`. Join the gate columns in so the CSV records WHY a
# component was routed to PE, matching the pooled driver's report.
gate_df <- bind_rows(lapply(names(bss_all), function(l) {
  gi <- bss_all[[l]]$gate_info
  if (is.null(gi)) return(NULL)
  gi |> select(any_of(c("fit","ar_resolution","divergence_fraction",
                        "impact_C_sd","impact_E_sd","distortion_C","distortion_E",
                        "pass_rhat","pass_neff","pass_div_fraction","pass_impact")))
}))
if (nrow(gate_df) > 0) {
  convergence_df <- convergence_df |>
    left_join(gate_df, by = "fit", suffix = c("", "_gate"))
}
message("\n")
report_table(convergence_df, caption = "Convergence and gate report")

# ===========================================================================
# 7.11b EXTENDED DIAGNOSTICS + PSIS-LOO
# Shared writers auto-sourced from 03_R_functions/:
#   write_bss_diagnostics()            structural params, divergence localization,
#                                      PPC calibration + PIT histogram
#   write_effort_overdispersion_diag()  Poisson / NB / latent variance decomposition
#   write_fit_extended_diagnostics()    O1-O9 (E-BFMI, AR paths, per-obs PIT,
#                                      prior-vs-posterior contraction, ...)
#   write_loo_diagnostics()             O13 PSIS-LOO + Pareto-k, from the
#                                      log_lik_gear/trailer/catch added to the
#                                      gear-resolved Stan model.
#
# These run for every fit that PRODUCED draws, including fits the convergence
# gate rejected. That is deliberate: a gate-failed fit reports PE in the totals,
# but its diagnostics are exactly what identify WHY it failed.
# ===========================================================================

message("\n", strrep("=",60), "\n EXTENDED DIAGNOSTICS\n", strrep("=",60), "\n")
for(label in names(bss_all)) {
  b <- bss_all[[label]]
  if(is.null(b$fit)) next   # PE-only (insufficient data): no draws to diagnose

  message(sprintf("\n--- diagnostics: %s (%s) ---\n", label,
              if(isTRUE(b$use_bss)) "gate PASS" else "gate FAIL -> reporting PE"))

  # 2026-08-30: the gate verdict travels INTO the per-fit tables (see the pooled driver).
  write_bss_diagnostics(b$fit, b$bss_data, label, output_dir,
                        fit_method = b$gate_info$method_selected %||%
                          (if (isTRUE(b$use_bss)) "BSS" else "PE (convergence fail)"))
  # 2026-09-04: see the note at the same call in BSS-GH-pooled-CPUE-model.Rmd.
  if (isTRUE(params$save_ppc_draws) && !is.null(b$bss_data))
    save_bss_ppc_draws(b$fit, b$bss_data, label, output_dir,
                       max_draws = params$save_ppc_draws_max %||% NULL)
  write_effort_overdispersion_diag(b$fit, b$bss_data, label, output_dir)
  # 2026-08-27: pass the run seed so the diagnostic draw subsampling is reproducible
  # (see the note in save_run_diagnostics.R; the port total stays RNG-sensitive regardless).
  write_fit_extended_diagnostics(b$fit, b$bss_data, b$days_ss, label, output_dir,
                                 seed = params$bss_seed %||% 1L)
  write_loo_diagnostics(b$fit, b$bss_data, b$days_ss, label, output_dir)
  # 2026-09-26 (D31 -> B39): leave-one-WEEK-out PSIS block CV of the effort streams; writes
  # loo_block_<stream>_<label>.csv, tryCatch-wrapped, changes no estimate (bss_block_cv.R).
  write_block_cv_diagnostics(b$fit, b$bss_data, b$days_ss, label, output_dir)
  # F4: CPUE estimator triad, saturation exponent, and the E/h unit assertion.
  # 2026-09-28 (B46): wrapped, as on the pooled track. bss_assert_effort_units() stop()s by
  # design, and an unwrapped error here aborted the render AFTER every fit, losing the rest
  # of the report, run_parameters.txt, session_info.txt and the manifest.
  tryCatch(write_cpue_diagnostics(b, label, output_dir),
           error = function(e)
             message(sprintf("  CPUE diagnostics skipped for %s: %s", label, conditionMessage(e))))
}

11. Daily combined estimate

The daily catch and effort series assembled from the fitted components, the fine-grained trajectory underneath the monthly roll-up.

# ===========================================================================
# 7.12 DAILY COMBINED ESTIMATE
# v5.1: Uses C_total instead of C[S][D,G]
# ===========================================================================

message("\n", strrep("=",60), "\n DAILY COMBINED ESTIMATE\n", strrep("=",60), "\n")
daily_combined <- list()

for(pop in c("shore","private_boat")) {
  for(ss in subseasons) {
    label_cg <- paste0(pop, "_", ss$name, "_Dungeness_Kept")
    pe_label <- paste0(pop, "_", ss$name)
    b <- bss_all[[label_cg]]

    days_ss <- prep_days_crab(ss$start, ss$end, params, L_eff_model)
    summ_ss <- prep_population_summary(dwg, pop, ss$start, ss$end, params)

    # improvement 1 (2026-08-25): this block used the crabber-hours pipeline
    # (crabbers x day_length effort, catch per crabber-hour) for BOTH populations, left
    # over from before the v7.6/v7.7 gear-deployment move. For the boat it also used the
    # SHORE multiplier (crabbers_per_gear against a trailer count), which is meaningless.
    # It now mirrors run_pe_gear()'s effort basis and CPUE denominator exactly, so the
    # daily series a PE-fallback component contributes agrees with that component's own
    # PE total instead of contradicting it.
    .spec_dc <- bss_effort_spec(pop == "shore", days_ss, params)
    if (pop == "shore") {
      .mult_dc <- if (.spec_dc$effort_scale_gear == 1L) 1.0 else summ_ss$crabbers_per_gear
      .L_dc    <- if (identical(.spec_dc$unit, "gear-deployments"))
                    (params$tau_shore_prior_mu %||% bss_tau_fallback("shore", params)) else NA_real_
      .f_dc    <- rep(1, nrow(days_ss))
    } else {
      .ng_dc   <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(summ_ss$interview$number_of_gear))
      .ng_dc   <- .ng_dc[is.finite(.ng_dc) & .ng_dc > 0]
      .mult_dc <- if (length(.ng_dc)) mean(.ng_dc) else (params$gear_per_group_default %||% 4.0)
      .L_dc    <- params$tau_boat_prior_mu %||% bss_tau_fallback("private_boat", params)
      .f_dc    <- crab_fraction_point_day(TRUE, days_ss, params)   # crab-directed, matching the PE
    }
    .h_dc <- .spec_dc$h_col

    pe_daily <- summ_ss$effort_index |>
      filter(count_sequence <= params$bss_max_count_seq) |>
      group_by(event_date) |>
      summarise(mean_count = mean(count_quantity), .groups = "drop") |>
      left_join(days_ss |> select(event_date, day_type, day_length), by = "event_date") |>
      left_join(tibble(event_date = days_ss$event_date, f_dc = .f_dc), by = "event_date") |>
      mutate(pe_effort_units = mean_count * .mult_dc *
                               (if (is.na(.L_dc)) day_length else .L_dc) * f_dc)

    # v5.2: Apply incomplete trip filter to PE CPUE in daily combined
    pe_cpue_int <- summ_ss$interview |>
      mutate(.hh = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[.h_dc]]))) |>
      filter(is.finite(.hh), .hh > 0)
    if(isTRUE(params$filter_incomplete_trips)) {
      pe_cpue_int <- pe_cpue_int |> filter(trip_status == "Complete" | is.na(trip_status))
    }
    pe_cpue <- pe_cpue_int |>
      group_by(event_date) |>
      summarise(catch = sum(Dungeness_Kept, na.rm=TRUE),
                hrs = sum(.hh, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop") |>
      mutate(pe_cpue = if_else(hrs > 0, catch/hrs, NA_real_))

    daily_pop <- days_ss |>
      select(event_date, day_type, day_length) |>
      mutate(population = pop, subseason = ss$name,
             effort_unit = .spec_dc$unit) |>
      left_join(pe_daily |> select(event_date, pe_effort_units), by = "event_date") |>
      left_join(pe_cpue |> select(event_date, pe_cpue), by = "event_date") |>
      mutate(pe_catch = pe_effort_units * pe_cpue)

    if(!is.null(b) && !bss_use_pe_for(b)) {   # B1.8: BSS only if it passed the gate
      E_bss <- rstan::extract(b$fit, "E")$E
      # v5.2: C_total is now expected value (smooth, no Poisson noise).
      # Good for daily trajectory plots. Season and monthly totals use it too (B44).
      C_total_bss <- rstan::extract(b$fit, "C_total")$C_total  # [draws, D]

      daily_pop$bss_effort_median <- apply(E_bss[,1,,1], 2, median)
      daily_pop$bss_effort_lo95  <- apply(E_bss[,1,,1], 2, quantile, 0.025)
      daily_pop$bss_effort_hi95  <- apply(E_bss[,1,,1], 2, quantile, 0.975)
      daily_pop$bss_catch_median <- apply(C_total_bss, 2, median)
      daily_pop$bss_catch_lo95   <- apply(C_total_bss, 2, quantile, 0.025)
      daily_pop$bss_catch_hi95   <- apply(C_total_bss, 2, quantile, 0.975)

      conv <- convergence_df |> filter(fit == label_cg)
      use_bss <- nrow(conv) > 0 && conv$pass_convergence[1]

      daily_pop$combined_effort <- if(use_bss) daily_pop$bss_effort_median else daily_pop$pe_effort_units
      daily_pop$combined_catch  <- if(use_bss) daily_pop$bss_catch_median  else daily_pop$pe_catch
      daily_pop$method <- if(use_bss) "BSS" else "PE"
    } else {
      daily_pop$bss_effort_median <- NA; daily_pop$bss_effort_lo95 <- NA; daily_pop$bss_effort_hi95 <- NA
      daily_pop$bss_catch_median <- NA; daily_pop$bss_catch_lo95 <- NA; daily_pop$bss_catch_hi95 <- NA
      daily_pop$combined_effort <- daily_pop$pe_effort_units
      daily_pop$combined_catch  <- daily_pop$pe_catch
      daily_pop$method <- "PE"
    }

    daily_combined[[length(daily_combined)+1]] <- daily_pop
  }
}
## 
##   shore [2025-09-16 to 2025-11-30]: 132 effort obs, 912 interviews, crab/gear=0.76, R_G_empirical=1.31
## 
##   shore [2025-12-01 to 2026-09-15]: 511 effort obs, 3844 interviews, crab/gear=0.79, R_G_empirical=1.26
## 
##   private_boat [2025-09-16 to 2025-11-30]: 94 effort obs, 2 interviews, crab/gear=1.57, R_G_empirical=0.64
## 
##   private_boat [2025-12-01 to 2026-09-15]: 369 effort obs, 268 interviews, crab/gear=0.87, R_G_empirical=1.15
daily_combined_df <- bind_rows(daily_combined) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 1))) |>
  arrange(event_date, population)

message(sprintf("  Daily combined estimate: %d rows (%d days x %d populations)\n",
            nrow(daily_combined_df), n_distinct(daily_combined_df$event_date),
            n_distinct(daily_combined_df$population)))
write.csv(daily_combined_df, file.path(output_dir, "daily_combined_estimate.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

12. Per-fit data coverage

How much observed data each fit rests on: latent days, effort observations, interviews, and the percent of days carrying any data. Healthy: read the thin-coverage fits (few interviews, low percent of days sampled) as the ones leaning hardest on the AR process and priors.

# ===========================================================================
# 7.13 DATA COVERAGE TABLE
# ===========================================================================

message("\n", strrep("=",60), "\n DATA COVERAGE\n", strrep("=",60), "\n")
coverage <- list()
for(pop in c("shore","private_boat")) {
  for(ss in subseasons) {
    days_ss <- prep_days_crab(ss$start, ss$end, params, L_eff_model)
    summ_ss <- prep_population_summary(dwg, pop, ss$start, ss$end, params)

    days_ss$month_label <- format(days_ss$event_date, "%Y-%m")

    total_days <- days_ss |> count(month_label, name = "total_days")

    effort_days <- summ_ss$effort_index |>
      mutate(month_label = format(event_date, "%Y-%m")) |>
      distinct(event_date, month_label) |>
      count(month_label, name = "effort_days")

    int_days <- summ_ss$interview |>
      mutate(month_label = format(event_date, "%Y-%m")) |>
      distinct(event_date, month_label) |>
      count(month_label, name = "interview_days")

    int_count <- summ_ss$interview |>
      mutate(month_label = format(event_date, "%Y-%m")) |>
      count(month_label, name = "n_interviews")

    cov <- total_days |>
      left_join(effort_days, by = "month_label") |>
      left_join(int_days, by = "month_label") |>
      left_join(int_count, by = "month_label") |>
      mutate(across(c(effort_days, interview_days, n_interviews), ~replace_na(., 0)),
             effort_coverage_pct = round(effort_days / total_days * 100, 0),
             population = pop, subseason = ss$name)

    coverage[[length(coverage)+1]] <- cov
  }
}
## 
##   shore [2025-09-16 to 2025-11-30]: 132 effort obs, 912 interviews, crab/gear=0.76, R_G_empirical=1.31
## 
##   shore [2025-12-01 to 2026-09-15]: 511 effort obs, 3844 interviews, crab/gear=0.79, R_G_empirical=1.26
## 
##   private_boat [2025-09-16 to 2025-11-30]: 94 effort obs, 2 interviews, crab/gear=1.57, R_G_empirical=0.64
## 
##   private_boat [2025-12-01 to 2026-09-15]: 369 effort obs, 268 interviews, crab/gear=0.87, R_G_empirical=1.15
coverage_df <- bind_rows(coverage) |>
  select(population, subseason, month_label, total_days, effort_days, effort_coverage_pct,
         interview_days, n_interviews) |>
  arrange(population, month_label)

message("\n")
report_table(coverage_df, caption = "Per-fit data coverage")

13. Effort and CPUE multipliers

The fitted structural quantities that shape the daily series: the weekend effort effect (B1), the holiday effort effect (B2), and the interview CPUE summary by month and population.

# ===========================================================================
# 7.14 EFFORT MULTIPLIER SUMMARY (B1, B2)
# ===========================================================================

message("\n", strrep("=",60), "\n EFFORT MULTIPLIERS (B1, B2)\n", strrep("=",60), "\n")
multiplier_results <- list()
for(label in names(bss_all)) {
  b <- bss_all[[label]]
  if(is.null(b$pe_fallback) || !b$pe_fallback) {
    B1_draws <- rstan::extract(b$fit, "B1")$B1
    B2_draws <- rstan::extract(b$fit, "B2")$B2

    weekend_mult <- exp(B1_draws)
    holiday_mult <- exp(B1_draws + B2_draws)

    multiplier_results[[label]] <- tibble(
      fit = label,
      B1_median = round(median(B1_draws), 3),
      B1_lo95 = round(quantile(B1_draws, 0.025), 3),
      B1_hi95 = round(quantile(B1_draws, 0.975), 3),
      weekend_multiplier = sprintf("%.1fx (%.1f-%.1f)",
        median(weekend_mult), quantile(weekend_mult, 0.025), quantile(weekend_mult, 0.975)),
      B2_median = round(median(B2_draws), 3),
      B2_lo95 = round(quantile(B2_draws, 0.025), 3),
      B2_hi95 = round(quantile(B2_draws, 0.975), 3),
      holiday_multiplier = sprintf("%.1fx (%.1f-%.1f)",
        median(holiday_mult), quantile(holiday_mult, 0.025), quantile(holiday_mult, 0.975))
    )
  }
}
if(length(multiplier_results) > 0) {
  multiplier_df <- bind_rows(multiplier_results)
  message("\n  Effort multipliers relative to weekdays:\n")
  for(i in 1:nrow(multiplier_df)) {
    message(sprintf("    %s:\n      Weekends: %s\n      Holidays: %s\n",
                multiplier_df$fit[i],
                multiplier_df$weekend_multiplier[i],
                multiplier_df$holiday_multiplier[i]))
  }
  write.csv(multiplier_df, file.path(output_dir, "effort_multipliers.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
}
# ===========================================================================
# 7.15 INTERVIEW CPUE SUMMARY BY MONTH x POPULATION
# ===========================================================================

message("\n", strrep("=",60), "\n INTERVIEW CPUE SUMMARY\n", strrep("=",60), "\n")
cpue_summary <- dwg$interview |>
  filter(fishing_time_total > 0, population %in% c("shore","private_boat")) |>
  mutate(
    month_label = format(event_date, "%Y-%m"),

  ) |>
  group_by(population, month_label) |>

    n_interviews = n(),
    mean_cpue = round(mean(cpue, na.rm=TRUE), 3),
    sd_cpue = round(sd(cpue, na.rm=TRUE), 3),
    se_cpue = round(sd(cpue, na.rm=TRUE) / sqrt(n()), 3),
    median_cpue = round(median(cpue, na.rm=TRUE), 3),
    mean_dungeness = round(mean(dungeness_kept, na.rm=TRUE), 1),
    mean_hours = round(mean(fishing_time_total, na.rm=TRUE), 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(population, month_label)

message("\n")

13.1 Effort day covariates as fitted

Every fit’s day-covariate block (K_open): which columns it carries, on how many of its days each column is set, and the fitted effect on the latent effort (B_open_out, with its rate ratio). Under the method of record (CHANGE_REGISTER A30) the private-boat all-gear fit carries the NWS Small-Craft-Advisory flag nws_sca_any and every other fit carries nothing (marine_hazard_gear_regimes, B42). Written to effort_day_covariates.csv; the same table as the pooled report’s section 12.2, so the cross-check compares like with like.

# 2026-09-28 (B43): the fitted day covariates per fit, from bss_all (bss_day_covariate_report.R).
day_cov_df <- tryCatch(bss_day_covariate_table(bss_all, params), error = function(e) {

  write.csv(day_cov_df, file.path(output_dir, "effort_day_covariates.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
# the table must be the chunk's LAST, top-level, visible value, or knitr shows the code and no table
if (!is.null(day_cov_df) && nrow(day_cov_df) > 0)
  report_table(day_cov_df[, c("fit", "covariate", "source", "days_flagged", "column_sum", "fit_days", "coef_median", "coef_lo95", "coef_hi95", "rate_ratio")],
